scope: Local exact-u64 native transaction JSON parsing and same-signed-claim journal reconciliation with synthetic metadata; includes actual loopback HTTP, not a new Agave settlement or production claim

runtime.workerProbeScope: Read-only runtime feature probe, no private ledger process started

guards: Original raw decimal JSON digits converted to bounded u64 BigInt before economic comparison
Negative, overflowing, fractional, exponent, string/null and missing/oversized metadata refuse finalization
Metadata account counts equal the exact signed transaction account keys
One-unit difference above Number precision rejects without changing submission count or journal state
Null/pruned transactions retain unresolved handling; existing both-direction tests pass
Node runtime without raw JSON number source support fails closed
remaining: Read-only large-metadata reconciliation on new copies of retained real Agave journal fixtures
Independent RPC/source-finality verification, signer custody and code/authority pins
Unknown landing/pending-operation crash/fork and reviewed extended origin mint handling
Actual funded mainnet backing/custody and security review
